baseline_note: Synthetic, hand-labelled cases, judged end to end: the word pool picks the candidates the engine sees from each case's notes, and a relevant note it leaves out ranks last. Measured 2026-10-23 with protocol openai, endpoint http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1 (local ninfer), model decision-1. The pool held 14 of the 15 relevant notes; release.md for "Bump the version and publish the crate" shares no word with it. The pool order scored nDCG@k 0.717 and recall@k 0.796. No threshold from 0.70 to 0.90 named an unrelated note, the best of which scored 0.50; 0.75 named 9 of the 15.
